_purpose: Cross-epic registry of CONFIRMED platform/form-factor behaviour divergences (iOS vs Android vs web-desktop vs mobile-web) for the Social+ product. PM does not spec these — 'same behaviour as before' is often false across platforms. QA discovers and maintains this. Consult BEFORE assuming uniform behaviour for any feature_area listed here; every new epic touching that area inherits the known split.
_rule: Only STANDING platform truths belong here (interaction-model / OS-capability / SDK-support differences) — NOT in-flight bugs or dev deltas being fixed for a specific epic (those go stale the moment they're fixed; keep them in that epic's own notes instead). An entry needs >=2 platforms with genuinely different behaviour text, real evidence, and an id.

entries.feature_area: Video / Live player — tap interaction model
entries.summary: First tap on a PLAYING player: mobile reveals controls without pausing (2-step to pause); web-desktop pauses directly on first tap (1-step).

platforms.ios: 2-step: tap reveals the controls overlay (playback continues); tap the center button to pause
platforms.web-desktop: 1-step: tap pauses directly, no intermediate reveal
platforms.mobile-web: 2-step: behaves like the mobile app, not like web-desktop

entries.summary: The 'Reconnecting' indicator is driven by a DIFFERENT signal per platform, so it appears at different times: iOS ties it to the device's own network monitor (shows even while the viewer has the stream paused); web ties it to the broadcaster/SDK room status (generally does NOT show for a plain viewer-side pause, only when the broadcaster itself drops).

platforms.ios: Full-screen scrim + spinner, driven by NWPathMonitor (device network) — shows while paused too, since it's about the viewer's own connectivity
platforms.android: Not yet code-verified — assume parity with iOS until checked (OS-level network monitor pattern is typical)
platforms.web-desktop: LivestreamOverlay Reconnecting spinner, gated on SDK room.status==='waitingReconnect' (broadcaster-side) — generally NOT shown for a viewer-side pause
platforms.mobile-web: Same mechanism as web-desktop (shared web player)
